note: Order is the observed wire order of this capture machine and is NOT significant for the Core: SelectAllTrustAnchorIDs() iterates an absl::flat_hash_set whose iteration order is a property of the table instance, so a restarted Chrome advertises a different permutation of the same set. The 28-ID set is identical to the chrome_152 capture set (missing d6790902, d6790903, d6790909, d679090e from the 32-entry compiled-in Chrome Root Store of the 153 tags) and, like 152's, is a component-updated value frozen into a version-keyed table; refreshing it needs a new capture set.
encoding: Sequence of one-byte-length-prefixed IDs, as net::AddTrustAnchorIdToEncodedList emits and SSL_set1_requested_trust_anchors consumes. BoringSSL adds the u16 list length when serializing, which is why the wire contents are two bytes longer.
